work_summary: Hardened the heartbeat prompt template in scripts/runtime/terminal-heartbeat-pulse.cjs: every woken session is now told that routine sweeps must never stage source code (packages/**/src, scripts/, apps/, .husky/, *.ts/*.cjs/*.sh), must commit only by explicit file path (never git add -A / commit -a), must put behavioral changes on task branches, and must stop-and-report on zero-diff or type-broken trees.

Added the two constraints as a 'Sweep Discipline' subsection of docs/core/AGENTS.md's Autonomous Commits and Pushes section (constraints 6-7), operator-approved in session; the authority-surface gate is satisfied via TNF_AUTHORITY_EDIT_CONFIRM for this sanctioned governance edit.

Audited scripts/runtime/subdirector-autopilot-loop.cjs: all writes go under ~/.tnf state dirs (lock dir, payload history, signal file) — it does not write repo files and is not the truncation agent. Loaded it back into launchd after the prompt hardening landed (state=running).

Verified the two currently-flagged services are governance-by-design, not defects: com.tnf.master-reconciliation is being preflight-denied by tnf-launchd-guard on load-average (21.5) with correct backoff; relay-monitor's SIGTERM is the resource watchdog shedding load. Both recover automatically when load drops.

verification.notes: node --check passes for the edited runtime script; launchctl print confirms com.tnf.subdirector-autopilot state=running; tnf services reports the remaining flags are watchdog load-shedding, not faults.

resume_checklist: Watch the next few fleet routine commits: sweeps should carry only data/docs/report paths.
Re-check services once machine load subsides; master-reconciliation should self-recover.
